item.title: Without a Tag, No One Can Recall You
item.description: 1. Everyone Is Equal Before the Machine Every day we take in a huge amount of digital information, but very little of it actually helps us. Most of it is like junk food: it provides no nourishment, yet it takes up capacity, leaving you unable to dig into the truth and form your own thinking and judgment.
